name: smwmusic-mega-man-star-force-moving-scene-star-mix
title: Mega Man Star Force - Moving Scene (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Moving Scene from Mega Man Star Force (which is basically a shortened variation of the game's Title theme). The Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection came out recently, and I thought I'd do a short mix for now (before doing an actual remix in the future) 'cuz Star Force 1 deserves it!!! SERIOUSLY, GO PLAY IT!!!

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. B Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. A# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
ㅤ3. C Minor (Custom Pitch 2)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Shortens the Intro (INTRO Shortened)
ㅤ3. Skips the Intro (INTRO Skipped)
